name: Spherical Gaussian Environment Map Representation
definition: An n-dimensional spherical Gaussian (SG) is a spherical function used to approximate the rendering equation in closed form. It is defined by a lobe axis, sharpness, and amplitude.
summary: Spherical Gaussian Environment Map Representation models distant illumination as a mixture of directional lobes, enabling efficient, analytically differentiable lighting and appearance computation without cubemaps.
